title: The James Brothers band
summary: After Gabriel quit, the four brothers formed the James Brothers, a string band with trumpeter Ollie Drefflin and occasionally Bunk.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Had your own band, yes. Yeah, our own band, you see. What did you call that? The James Brothers. James Brothers. Uh huh.
About the same size band, would that be?
Yeah, about the same size band. Fifteen pieces? No, no, that's a brass band. No, that's a string band.
Oh, how many pieces did you have?
Well, the Gabriel band band, how many? You had six pieces in the Gabriel band.
He had slide and trombone, he had his violin, guitar, bass, drums and trumpets. Oh, I see, yeah.
Uh huh. And then your own band, when you had the James Brothers band. We had the same amount.

Yeah, well, let me see, I had saxophone and clarinet, bass, and drums and trumpet. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Who was the trumpet with your band? Uh, Ollie Drefflin. He was out of Thibodeau, right? Yeah, yeah, from Shrebus, Louisiana. Ollie Drefflin. Then we had at one time, Bunk used to come out there and play with us. Oh, Bunk played with us? Yeah, yeah. And, uh, just all of them.
